name: code-performance-optimization-synthetic
description: Synthetic slow->fast Python function pairs (time and memory) for training a small seq2seq / decoder-only code model.
notes: train/val/test are disjoint and deterministically shuffled from meta.seed.
tests[].expected is a single value; tests[].acceptable (optional) lists multiple acceptable values when the answer is non-unique.
benchmark.args is a larger input used by the validation harness to measure original vs optimized speed and memory.
materialize_output=True means the result is a generator; compare list(result).
